claim_boundaries: The exact quadratic contraction and false affine-line attack are proved algebraically.
Exact finite noise probabilities are obtained by exhaustive dynamic programming over the implemented weighted ternary sum.
The characteristic-zero radial-polynomial escape lemma is limited to finite-degree radial polynomial gates; it is not a generic nonlinear impossibility theorem.
No LWE theorem is claimed for the structured radial capsule.
No arbitrary-QPT key-recovery-to-short-preimage reduction is claimed.
Tests validate implemented identities and attacks; they are not treated as a security proof.
